name: Your current setup
description: The installation as it is now, including your existing autoexec. This is not necessarily Valve stock.

name: Uncapped FPS
description: Test the render ceiling. Compare frame consistency and power as well as average FPS.

name: 144 FPS cap
description: Test consistency at a 144 FPS cap. A lower average FPS is expected and is not alone a regression.

name: 240 FPS cap
description: Test consistency at a 240 FPS cap; compare the budget-miss rate and slowest frames.

name: Vulkan renderer
description: Compare Vulkan with your current renderer. Warm each renderer separately; driver and Proton versions matter.

name: DirectX 11 through Proton
description: Compare the DX11 path under Proton. Confirm the renderer in the run log; support can change with game updates.

name: OptimizationLock default
description: Whole-file community snapshot from 2026-09-04. Changes many variables; compare visual quality and verify current-build compatibility.

name: OptimizationLock test
description: Development snapshot from 2026-09-04. May break replay progression or visuals; not an endorsed upgrade.

name: Boot maximum FPS
description: Upstream describes this snapshot as unmaintained. Strong visual tradeoffs; test locally and inspect the camera.

name: Kaizu minimum spec
description: Aggressive visual reductions. Multi-variable snapshot; higher FPS does not establish acceptable visibility.
